hero.heading: 24/7 towing and recovery in Southfield and Metro Detroit since 1962
hero.sub: Family owned. Towing, heavy recovery and spill response around the clock, plus a licensed freight carrier for Michigan, Ohio and Indiana.
paths: Request online: Tow, Freight, Machinery (Towbook links)
strip: Farmington Hills PD and Michigan State Police towing

towing.heading: Towing, day or night
towing.lede: We're staffed 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. One call and a Ross truck comes to you.
cards: Police towing and impounds: contracted with the Michigan State Police and the Farmington Hills Police Department

heavy.heading: Heavy duty, recovery and lifting
heavy.feature: 50 ton rotator: handles semi trucks, fire trucks, buses and similar heavy vehicles
cards: Machinery hauling and rigging: machine hauling, off loading, staging and rigging (Nov 5 email)

spill.heading: One of only two licensed towing companies permitted to respond anywhere in Michigan
spill.lede: Ross Towing is a licensed and permitted hazardous spill and material cleanup company. We specialize in diesel fuel and petroleum based oil containment and cleanup.
facts: An incident commander available for 24 hour response
equipment: Three spill trailers with diesel pump off stations, pump sprayers, absorbents, booms and pools
Biohazard friendly roadway degreaser that leaves only H2O and CO2, safe for storm water runoff
Two skid steers with power sweeper attachments, plus a self contained 10 yard street sweeper
A tri-axle dump trailer for hauling debris from scenes
An enclosed EV storage area with a three sided brick wall

ppi.heading: Private Property Impounds (PPI)
ppi.lede: Unauthorized or abandoned vehicles on your property? We post a Ross Towing sign and remove unauthorized vehicles at the vehicle owner's expense, 24 hours a day.
ppi.law: Under Michigan Law (MCL 257.252a), an abandoned vehicle is any motor vehicle left on public or private property without the consent of the owner. (Jennifer's wording, linked to legislature.mi.gov)
steps: Download and print the property owner authorization form
Fill it out and sign it
